description: The customer master exists and holds no record. The first READ at app/cbl/CBCUS01C.cbl:L93 reports '10', so 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, the 88 APPL-EOF condition at L107 holds, END-OF-FILE becomes 'Y' at L108, and the mainline's second IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' guard at L77 suppresses the display for the read that found nothing - so neither of the two displays fires. The whole of SYSOUT is the two banners, and the dataset-level expectation states what no row expectation can: the dataset was opened and holds zero rows at its declared 500-byte width.
